fm.title: Filtering
fm.description: HDL-optimized streaming filters and rate-change filters (10 blocks)

rows.intent: HDL-optimized cascaded biquad (second-order-section) IIR filter — use for hardware-efficient IIR filtering of a streaming sample input on FPGA/ASIC.
HDL-optimized CIC (cascaded integrator-comb) decimation filter — use for multiplier-free high-ratio downsampling in hardware.
HDL-optimized CIC interpolation filter — use for multiplier-free high-ratio upsampling in hardware.
HDL-optimized polyphase channel synthesizer — use to combine multiple baseband channels into one wideband stream in hardware.
HDL-optimized polyphase channelizer — use to split a wideband signal into multiple frequency channels in hardware.
HDL-optimized FIR filter on a streaming input — use for hardware-efficient linear-phase filtering on FPGA/ASIC.
HDL-optimized polyphase FIR decimation filter — use to filter and downsample in one hardware block.
HDL-optimized polyphase FIR interpolation filter — use to filter and upsample in one hardware block.
HDL-optimized FIR rational-rate (L/M) converter — use for combined interpolation and decimation in hardware.
HDL-optimized adaptive LMS filter — use for hardware adaptive filtering such as noise/echo cancellation and equalization.

fm.title: Math functions
fm.description: HDL-optimized math on streaming samples (1 blocks)

rows.intent: HDL-optimized CORDIC conversion of a complex sample to magnitude and phase angle — use for hardware envelope/phase computation.

fm.title: Signal operations
fm.description: HDL-optimized resampling and sample-rate operations (5 blocks)

rows.intent: HDL-optimized downsampler that keeps every Nth streaming sample — use to reduce sample rate in hardware.
HDL-optimized Farrow fractional-delay rate converter — use for arbitrary/fractional resampling in hardware.
HDL-optimized numerically controlled oscillator generating sine/cosine from a phase accumulator — use as a hardware carrier or local-oscillator source.
HDL-optimized upsampler that inserts zeros between streaming samples — use to increase sample rate in hardware.
HDL-optimized numerically controlled oscillator generating sine/cosine from a phase accumulator — use as a hardware carrier or local-oscillator source.
HDL-optimized streaming FFT — use for hardware frequency-domain transforms on FPGA/ASIC.
HDL-optimized streaming inverse FFT — use for hardware time-domain reconstruction on FPGA/ASIC.
